edit_rules: Changing ASSUMED_WIDTH or ASSUMED_HEIGHT scales the plate outline but must maintain the relative positions of holes and slot.
Changing ASSUMED_THICKNESS affects the depth of all cutouts.
Changing ASSUMED_HOLE_DIAMETER affects both holes simultaneously.
Changing ASSUMED_SLOT_LENGTH or ASSUMED_SLOT_WIDTH affects the central slot dimensions.
